clubs.name: Prague Running Crew — Track Tuesday
clubs.desc: Interval-focused speed sessions at the track. Open to all levels with structured goals. Part of the broader Prague Running Crew.

clubs.name: Prague Running Crew — Saturday Run
clubs.desc: Social Saturday long run with route options: 7km (Groovy), 12km, and 18km. Coffee and bakery social before the start.

clubs.name: Prague Social Runners — Wed Vltava
clubs.desc: 9km flat route along the Vltava riverbank. Relaxed atmosphere, all welcome. One of Prague's most popular midweek social runs.

clubs.name: Prague Social Runners — Sat Stromovka
clubs.desc: 50-minute social run through Stromovka park. Casual, beginner-friendly, great for meeting the running community.

clubs.name: LOVE THEM Running Club — Tue 5K
clubs.desc: Social 5km run at an easy, conversational pace. Welcoming community for beginners and casual runners.

clubs.name: LOVE THEM Running Club — Sun 14K
clubs.desc: Longer 14km Sunday run from the same starting point. Same friendly, social vibe stretched over more distance.

clubs.name: Nomilesnosmiles — Tue Community Run
clubs.desc: Community run with a strong local crew. Check their Instagram for the exact meeting point each week.

clubs.name: Nomilesnosmiles — Wed Track
clubs.desc: Track-focused midweek session. Speed work and intervals in a group setting.

clubs.name: Nomilesnosmiles — Sun Long Run
clubs.desc: Easy Sunday long run. Great way to close out the week with the crew.

clubs.name: Groovy Girls Run Club
clubs.desc: A running community specifically for female beginners. 4km run at a comfortable, non-intimidating pace. Supportive and encouraging.

clubs.name: Viva Sports — Sunday Social 5K
clubs.desc: 5K run followed by breakfast and conversation. Combines fitness with community and good food.

clubs.name: Top4Running Club
clubs.desc: Coach-led workouts twice a week for beginners and experienced runners alike. No registration needed — just show up.

clubs.name: Trailpoint Run Club
clubs.desc: Trail-focused sessions departing from Letná. Includes terrain runs, headlamp testing, and specialised workshops.

clubs.name: Next.Move Run Club
clubs.desc: Free and open to members and non-members. Three Sunday groups: Quick 5K (faster, continuous pace for pushing speed), Social 5K (relaxed, conversational pace) and Mid 8K (moderate pace for building distance).

clubs.name: Esse Athletes
clubs.desc: Performance and marathon-focused training. Wednesday: Speed Club (tempo/intervals). Sunday: long runs.

clubs.name: Running Mall (RunCzech Training Center)
clubs.desc: Fee-based structured programs: Wake Up Run, Sunrise Run (bi-weekly Fridays, intervals + hills), VO2max Boost, and Running Technique.

clubs.name: Mattoni FreeRun
clubs.desc: Free coach-led training sessions in Stromovka every Monday. Structured workout with professional guidance at no cost.

clubs.name: Old Town Running
clubs.meet: Bar No. 7, Na Struze 7, Nové Město
clubs.desc: Midweek social run from central Prague with 4–12 km route options, followed by drinks. Open to all abilities.

clubs.name: FF RUNclub — Na Knížecí
clubs.desc: Trainer-led group runs from the Form Factory gym. Included for members and MultiSport holders; book via the app.

clubs.name: Running with FINEP — Malý háj
clubs.meet: Trio Malý háj Café, Honzíkova 635/6, Praha 10
clubs.desc: Free weekly run, year-round. Training adapted to participants' level; suitable from age 12.

clubs.name: Running with FINEP — Britská čtvrť
clubs.desc: Free weekly run, year-round. Training adapted to participants' level; suitable from age 12.

clubs.name: Vinohrady Social Run Club — Thursday Social 5K
clubs.meet: Church of the Sacred Heart, nám. Jiřího z Poděbrad, Vinohrady
clubs.desc: Relaxed, social 5 km run around Vinohrady, open to beginners, with optional drinks afterwards. Runs weekly on Thursday evenings.

clubs.name: Běžecká škola Prahy 3 (Smart Running) — Wednesday
clubs.desc: Free weekly coached running sessions for all levels, led by Smart Running coaches around Vítkov hill. No sign-up needed; the exact start spot within the Pražačka area is not published.

clubs.name: proBĚH — Monday Group Run
clubs.desc: Open neighbourhood running group in Horní Měcholupy led by coach David Henke, at a conversational pace. No fees and no registration.
